page.layout: One page of text, full width, with a rule and a catchword line below it. No margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right.

main_text.p: propter Te jam Domine, & Redemptoris Mei charitatem, illud firme in corde meo statuo omnes modos Amuciftiæ, & Indemnitatis experiri, quò & metus omnes pellam, & suspiciones oblivione sepeliam.
Tuis ita in Me & Meos misericordiis potiar ut Veritatem & Pacem firme volo.

p.i: Auribus percipe orationem meam Domine non è labiis dolosis prodeuntem.

main_text.p: Benedictus Deus qui non repulit orationem meam, nec misericordiam suam a Me subduxit.

p.i: Anima Mea devolve super Dominum viam tuam: Spera in eo, & ipse faciet.

main_text.p: Sin Tu nolis Me & Meos restituere, quis sum ego qui tibi insulsum tribuam?
Tu (Domine) dedisti & abstulisti. Sit no-men Domini Benedictum: Laudetur Nomen Do-mini,

p.i: Fœlix sit Populus Meus & Ecclesia, si nun[?] mecum una, at sine Me.

page.notes: The word after "si" in the last paragraph is hard to read; it looks like "nun" and is marked [?]. The "ɪ" in the page number is a printed mark, read as 221. The catchword "26. Cum" is printed in large type at the lower right. The woodcut-like rule and the signature "L 3" are as printed. The top edge of the scan shows a dark stain and show-through, which are left out.
